intent: Port the approved single-page Gik & Go landing (index.html) to a Next.js static-export app and configure Cloudflare Workers static-asset hosting. LINE OA explicitly deferred by the user.
flow: User journey: owner edits content/builds with npm run build -> static export out/ -> wrangler deploy serves the site; visitor opens site, reads hero/chat mock, services with prices, 3-step strip, why/guarantee, FAQ, clicks LINE CTA. Implementation journey: copy approved CSS/copy/assets into Next.js app router page, add wrangler.jsonc assets config, verify via local production serve and screenshots.
scope_rationale: Micro: one page, no new product scope, design already approved via design-first in this session; framework and deploy target are technical choices owned by the agent per the purpose gate.

conventions.rule: Approved visual design and Thai-first bilingual copy come verbatim from index.html and design/design-decision.md; no restyling in this feature
conventions.plan_application: Port CSS and copy as-is into the Next.js page; only structural changes allowed are those Next.js requires (head metadata, asset imports)

conventions.rule: Full-res PNG art is canonical (assets/png-cut for cutouts, assets/png for scenes); SVG vector versions are masters only, never page-loaded at current sizes
conventions.plan_application: Copy those PNGs into public/ and reference them

conventions.rule: Next.js static export (output:'export') plus Workers Assets is the hosting model; no server runtime
conventions.plan_application: next.config with output export; wrangler.jsonc with assets.directory=out; npm run deploy wraps wrangler deploy
